title: Toggle Light Bulbs
description:
You are given an array bulbs.

There are 100 bulbs (1 to 100), all initially off.

For each value bulbs[i]:

If that bulb is off → turn it on
If it is on → turn it off

After processing all values, return:

A list of bulb numbers that are on
Sorted in ascending order

If no bulbs are on, return [-1].

Example 1
Input: [10,30,20,10]
Output: [20,30]

Example 2
Input: [100,100]
Output: [-1]
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n.
The second line contains n space-separated integers.
output_format: Print space-separated integers in one line.
